translation.title: Flurbiprofen Plaster
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for pain relief and anti-inflammation in degenerative arthritis (osteoarthritis), periarthritis of the shoulder, tendinitis and tenosynovitis, epicondylitis of the humerus (tennis elbow, etc.), muscle pain, and post-traumatic swelling and pain.
translation.usage: Remove the release liner from the adhesive side and apply the plaster to the affected area twice a day. Wipe off sweat from the application site before use.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are or have been hypersensitive to it, or if you have or have had aspirin-induced asthma (asthma attacks caused by non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, etc.). Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have bronchial asthma, if you are pregnant, a child, or elderly, or if you have inflammation accompanying an infection or a chronic condition. Do not use it on damaged skin or mucous membranes, or on areas with eczema or rash. Wipe off sweat from the application site before use. Adverse reactions may occur - sometimes redness, rash, drug eruption, itching and burning sensation, contact dermatitis, or asthma attacks (dry crackles, wheezing, difficulty breathing, etc.); if any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature away from light, and keep out of reach of children.
